name: The Wayfinding Stone
description: A palm-sized river stone that grows warm when pointed toward something you have lost.
questions: What did it cost you to learn its secret?
prerequisites: Spend a night meditating on what you have lost.

moves.name: Seek with the Stone
moves.trigger: When you hold the stone and name something you have lost...

outcomes.10+: The stone points true. Mark 1 charge.
outcomes.7-9: The stone points true, but something else notices. Mark 1 charge.
outcomes.6-: The stone goes cold. Mark XP.
